title: Sig Sauer P320 M18 Product Review
description:
In this product review from Sharp's Shooting Supply, we discuss the Sig Sauer P320 M18. This firearm is chambered in 9mm and has a 17+1 capacity magazine. It features a coyote PVD finish for corrosion resistance, ambidextrous safety, slide release, and mag release, a 3 dot night sight picture, and an optics cut rail. The firearm weighs 28.1 ounces and is compatible with Sig Romeo and Leupold red dots. It has a serialized fire control unit that allows for swapping out frame sizes. The M18 version has resolved previous drop safety concerns. The civilian model of the M18 can be identified by the serial number starting with an M. The firearm comes with 2 21+1 capacity magazines and some additional accessories. Overall, the Sig Sauer P320 M18 is recommended as a great concealed carry or everyday carry firearm.

Thanks for checking out our latest review. Be sure to visit us at www.sharpsshootingsupply.com!
